 Clippers vs Warriors Prediction, Picks & Best Bet for Tonight's NBA Game
 Tom Oldfield 
 • Betting Analyst 
 22+ years betting experience 
 Updated: 
Nov 1, 2026 , 02:19 PM ET
 • 4 min read 
 The Warriors are a different animal without Steph Curry, and that puts Darius Garland and the Clippers in prime position for a much-needed road win tonight.
 Jump to section: 
 Prediction 
 Combo 
 Player Props 
 Odds 
 nba
 Nov 01 • 3:30 PM ET 
 Photo By - Reuters Connect. Custom image of Keaton Wagler and Brandin Podziemski. 
 Three straight wins have steadied Golden State, but it will be without Steph Curry for tonight's clash with the Clippers.
 The Warriors still enter as 2.5-point favorites, but my Clippers vs. Warriors prediction backs L.A. to snap its four-game skid, with Darius Garland shining as the most dangerous player on the court at Chase Center.
 Check out my NBA picks for a closer look at this Sunday, Nov. 1 matchup, with tip-off at 8:30 p.m. ET.
  TOP PICK 
Clippers vs Warriors prediction: Clippers moneyline
 The Golden State Warriors have had some glimpses of life without Steph Curry , and it's not pretty. They were 13-26 SU without Curry last season , and he's just as irreplaceable now, ranking among the league's top five starters in usage rate this year.
 That opens the door for the Los Angeles Clippers . Despite a tough 1-4 start, L.A. has held three of its five opponents under 110 points, and a Darius Garland -led offense can create easy buckets tonight with Draymond Green joining Curry in street clothes.
 The visitors are missing key starters too, but they have athletic defensive stoppers to throw at Yaxel Lendeborg and went 14-10 ATS as a road underdog last year.
 The Clippers have won eight of the past 10 meetings between these teams, and I'd play this up to 50%.
 COVERS INTEL: The Warriors rank in the bottom third of the NBA in defensive rating (115.3) — a number that should drop further with Draymond Green ruled out — so this is a favorable matchup for the Clippers to score efficiently. 
 Enjoying Covers content? Add us as a preferred source on your Google account Clippers vs Warriors combo
 With Garland, Rui Hachimura and rookie Keaton Wagler , the Clippers look faster and better equipped to navigate a low-scoring contest, so I'll take the points with the Under here.
 The Under has cashed in two of L.A.'s last three games, and the visitors are averaging just 105.4 PPG (second-lowest in the NBA). Without Curry to anchor the Golden State offense and role players on both squads being pushed into bigger spots , this total feels too high, and the Warriors' 3-point edge will take a hit here.
 Lendeborg has hit the ground running in his rookie year, and I expect his rebound total to climb without Green in the lineup. He's already averaging 7.8 RPG, and he's grabbed 9+ boards in four of his last five outings .
 Clippers vs Warriors combo
 Clippers +2.5
 Under 221.5
 Yaxel Lendeborg Over 7.5 rebounds
 Clippers vs Warriors player props
 Clippers player prop: Keaton Wagler Over 13.5 points
 Some rookie inefficiency is no surprise, but Wagler has started his first season in attack mode. He's averaging 14.4 ppg while making his 3-pointers at a 36% clip, and he'll be another L.A. beneficiary of Green's absence in the paint tonight.
 Wagler can pad his scoring at the charity stripe, too. He's attempted 20 free throws across his last two outings, and he's logged 7.8 FTA per game so far this season .
 Like the Warriors, the Clippers are missing proven scorers, so Wagler has a clear path to shot volume off the bench.
 Warriors player prop: Brandin Podziemski Over 4.5 assists
 Brandin Podziemski has looked good since returning from back soreness, and his numbers will get a boost here without Curry or Green to run the offense — that duo is combining for 11.2 APG so far this year.
 Podziemski is stepping into the lead guard spot, which should make him a lock for big minutes, and he's dished 5+ assists in three straight contests .
 While Golden State may struggle through scoring droughts, Podz is the leading candidate to penetrate into the paint against the Clippers and find open shooters.
